inventory_status_reconciliation.scope: Rechecked the two published active exams whose seed records still described beta availability. No launch date was inferred.

records.observation: Python Institute lists PCEA-30-01 as active in its exam specifications. The credential page also lists Automation Specialist as an alternate title for Automation Engineer.

The issuer lists the GitHub Certified Agentic AI Developer credential, GH-600 study guide and scheduling route without a beta designation. The published guide already identified the current delivery status.

independent_review.type: Fresh-context AI integration and evidence review
independent_review.summary: Fresh-context AI integration review. Resolved the earlier inventory narrative discrepancy and verified the PCEA and GH-600 issuer status evidence, revised GH-600 guide and unchanged objective binding. Case-sensitive Git checks matched all 240 inventory and table rows, 227 full guide and objective hash pairs, their packet references, and the 27 packet commits already published on main. The 14 closing monitor checks, 58 failed source rechecks, 360 metadata deltas, 58 added or rerouted sources, 23 flagged discovery sources and 43 targeted corrections reconcile. Public evidence omits ephemeral OAuth query state. Assessment was a targeted change and evidence review without human, booking or lab validation.
